request.description:
Request history time buckets across the retained journal.

- `timeframe` (query, string, optional): Rolling window: hour (60 one-minute buckets), day (96 fifteen-minute buckets), week (84 two-hour buckets), month (90 eight-hour buckets over 30 days).

exec: pm.test("No reported operation failure", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); if (b.exitCode !== undefined) pm.expect(b.exitCode).to.equal(0); });

pm.test("History bucket contract", () => { const b=pm.response.json(); const counts={hour:60,day:96,week:84,month:90}; pm.expect(b.buckets.length).to.equal(counts[b.timeframe]); pm.expect(b.totalCount).to.equal(b.totalSuccess+b.totalFailure); pm.expect(b.buckets.reduce((n,x)=>n+x.ok+x.failed,0)).to.equal(b.totalCount); });
